sentences.en: That's a really good question.
sentences.zh: 这是个非常好的问题。

sentences.en: Yeah, but you know, that is so hard to answer.
sentences.zh: 是啊，但你知道，这真的很难回答。

sentences.en: Because if you had asked me that about note to self, I wouldn't have.
sentences.zh: 因为如果你当初问我关于《Note to Self》的问题，我也不会……

sentences.en: I mean, shit happens and you have no idea.
sentences.zh: 我是说，世事难料，你根本不知道。

sentences.en: It would make me sunset this whole thing.
sentences.zh: 什么会让我终止这一切。

sentences.en: Is it a better opportunity?
sentences.zh: 是更好的机会吗？

sentences.en: It's like.
sentences.zh: 就像是……

sentences.en: No, because this is the best opportunity.
sentences.zh: 不，因为这就是最好的机会。

sentences.en: But let me ask you this.
sentences.zh: 但让我问你一个问题。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Do you just make 99 PI forever?
sentences.zh: 你打算永远做《99% Invisible》吗？

sentences.en: Well, I wonder that too.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我也在想这个问题。

sentences.en: I've given myself a kind of a timeline of I need to make it as successful as possible.
sentences.zh: 我给自己设定了一个时间表，我需要让它尽可能地成功。

sentences.en: I'm 43 now.
sentences.zh: 我现在43岁了。

sentences.en: I don't know if the end of it is going to happen when I'm 50.
sentences.zh: 我不知道它是否会在我50岁时结束。

sentences.en: I think I would probably go your route faster.
sentences.zh: 我想我可能会更快地走你的路。

sentences.en: Like right now, people are doing projects inside of the group of 99% Invisible, which will be new things for the world.
sentences.zh: 比如现在，人们正在《99% Invisible》的团队内部做项目，这对世界来说将是新鲜事物。

sentences.en: And I can't really talk about them, but we could say this much.
sentences.zh: 我不能透露具体内容，但我们可以说这么多。

sentences.en: And I could imagine that my life is not hosting a show, but running a shop.
sentences.zh: 我可以想象，我的人生不再是主持节目，而是经营一家店。

sentences.en: And also it's just like, I feel myself more tired than I ever have.
sentences.zh: 而且，我感觉自己比以往任何时候都累。

sentences.en: And I just can't, I can't work this hard forever.
sentences.zh: 我真的不能，我不能永远这么拼命工作。

sentences.en: Roman, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: Roman，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: You're welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Well, like not just for the interview, but like you guys are taking a chance.
sentences.zh: 嗯，不仅仅是为了这次采访，而是你们在冒险。

sentences.en: Oh, no, but it's a good chance.
sentences.zh: 哦，不，这是一次很好的冒险。

sentences.en: Like it's like, that's the thing.
sentences.zh: 就像是，关键就在这里。

sentences.en: It's like, it's more your chance.
sentences.zh: 这更多是你们的冒险。

sentences.en: That's why Radiotopia works.
sentences.zh: 这就是Radiotopia成功的原因。

sentences.en: It's like, I don't own it.
sentences.zh: 我不拥有它。

sentences.en: You know, we don't own it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们不拥有它。

sentences.en: It's your chance to take.
sentences.zh: 这是你们要承担的风险。

sentences.en: We just get to be a part of it.
sentences.zh: 我们只是有幸参与其中。

sentences.en: And we like to be a part of things that we're proud of.
sentences.zh: 我们喜欢参与那些让我们引以为豪的事情。

sentences.en: Our session with Roman kind of felt like a motivational pep talk.
sentences.zh: 我们与Roman的这次谈话感觉就像是一次励志动员会。

sentences.en: But we didn't have to stand on chairs and yell like at a Tony Robbins event.
sentences.zh: 但我们不需要像在Tony Robbins的活动上那样站在椅子上大喊大叫。

sentences.en: This pep talk was way more chill than that.
sentences.zh: 这次动员会比那要轻松多了。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: No, it's my pleasure.
sentences.zh: 不，这是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: I'm so happy you're here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你们能来。

sentences.en: This conversation was just what we needed.
sentences.zh: 这次谈话正是我们所需要的。

sentences.en: Jen and I were resolved.
sentences.zh: 我和珍下定了决心。

sentences.en: Investment money, for now, was not for us.
sentences.zh: 投资款，至少目前，不适合我们。

sentences.en: Another zig.
sentences.zh: 又一次转折。

sentences.en: And then we zagged.
sentences.zh: 然后我们换了个方向。

sentences.en: We knew that we needed to focus on making the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 我们知道自己需要专注于制作播客。

sentences.en: This podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 就是这个播客。

sentences.en: Stick to the mission.
sentences.zh: 坚持使命。

sentences.en: And then if we made it that far, we'd reassess.
sentences.zh: 如果能做到那一步，我们再重新评估。

sentences.en: So we went back to New York and we even put a big red circle around one summer day on the calendar.
sentences.zh: 于是我们回到纽约，甚至在日历上圈出了一个夏日，画了一个大红圈。

sentences.en: And we labeled it Financial Reckoning Day.
sentences.zh: 我们把它标记为“财务清算日”。

sentences.en: But it felt good to know we had the support of not just one, but two collectives.
sentences.zh: 但知道我们不仅得到了一个，而是两个团体的支持，感觉真好。

sentences.en: Roman and Radiotopia, who are distributing this show and selling sponsorship.
sentences.zh: 一个是罗曼和Radiotopia，他们负责发行这个节目并销售赞助。

sentences.en: And Civil, the experiment using the blockchain to create a new ecosystem for independent journalists.
sentences.zh: 另一个是Civil，这是一个利用区块链为独立记者创造新生态系统的实验。

sentences.en: Sure, the whole thing was dicey.
sentences.zh: 当然，整件事风险很大。

sentences.en: But they had given us just enough money to pay the bills.
sentences.zh: 但他们给我们的钱刚好够支付账单。

sentences.en: And maybe the token thing would actually work.
sentences.zh: 或许代币那套东西真的能行得通。

sentences.en: Anyway, the Civil people felt like our people.
sentences.zh: 总之，Civil的人让我们感觉志同道合。

sentences.en: You've been listening to ZigZag.
sentences.zh: 您刚才收听的是《ZigZag》。

sentences.en: Go subscribe to it now, and maybe I can talk Manoush and Jen into having me on the show again.
sentences.zh: 现在就去订阅吧，说不定我能说服马努什和珍再次邀请我上节目。

sentences.en: Find it at zigzagpod.com on Apple Podcasts, Radio Public, or wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请访问zigzagpod.com，或在Apple Podcasts、Radio Public以及任何您获取播客的地方收听。

sentences.zh: Radiotopia。
